question: Should LongCat be accepted as a bundled provider plugin in OpenClaw core, or should it start as an external/ClawHub provider using the current provider SDK?
rationale: The provider SDK can express the requested behavior, but repository direction keeps core lean and treats optional bundled providers and new setup/auth surfaces as product ownership decisions.

options.title: Bundle after PR repair
options.body: Accept the linked PR path once its review findings, endpoint metadata, docs, tests, and key-gated live validation plan are ready.

options.title: External provider first
options.body: Move the same provider shape to an official external or ClawHub package and revisit bundling only if demand and ownership justify core inclusion.

options.title: Custom-provider docs only
options.body: Decline an official provider for now and rely on the documented models.providers workaround until there is clearer demand or ownership.

recommendation.title: Bundle after PR repair
recommendation.body: Accept the linked PR path once its review findings, endpoint metadata, docs, tests, and key-gated live validation plan are ready.
